data.gender_notes: Leonce is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word leo, meaning lion. Symbolizing power, courage, and royalty. The name Leonce carries the meaning “Lion strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Leonce usually hope their child will grow to embody lion strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
